//: Editor support for mods written inside this repository. TypeScript's language server picks the nearest config, so packages/ with their own tsconfig are unaffected — this exists so a mod in ./mods or ./examples resolves @pal-up/mod-sdk without npm install, and offers the real capabilities. No baseUrl: since TypeScript 4.4 a path maps relative to this file, and baseUrl is on its way out in 7.0.
